security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from documentation examples, Markdown relative links, and marketing terminology. One medium filesystem issue remains: the utility can write a CSV to a user-supplied output path. No prompt injection, credential handling, command execution, or network request behavior was found.

remediation.suggestion: Constrain --output to a safe output directory, reject absolute paths and parent traversal, and warn before overwriting existing files.
Label placeholder URLs and relative Markdown links as documentation examples to make future automated review easier.

content.value_statement: Marketing campaigns need clear strategy, channel planning, assets, and measurement. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured workflows, templates, and a UTM utility.
actual_capabilities: Guides campaign planning from objectives through reporting.
Provides channel frameworks for email, social media, paid ads, and content.
Supplies templates for emails, landing pages, ads, case studies, and campaign briefs.
Defines funnel metrics, KPI dashboards, and attribution approaches.
Includes a Python utility for UTM generation, tracking URL validation, and CSV batch output.
Offers brand voice and visual consistency guidance.
limitations: Does not run ad platforms, send emails, or publish social posts.
Requires users to supply current brand, budget, audience, and performance data.
The UTM utility does not fetch web pages or verify destination availability.
Marketing advice needs human review for legal, privacy, and brand claims.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Campaign
use_cases.description: Build a launch plan with audience segments, messaging, channels, assets, and campaign KPIs.

use_cases.title: Create Channel Content
use_cases.description: Draft email, social, ad, landing page, and blog content from consistent campaign messaging.

use_cases.title: Measure Campaign Performance
use_cases.description: Select funnel metrics, create UTM links, and prepare a readable reporting structure.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a marketing campaign for [product]. The goal is [goal], the audience is [audience], and the launch date is [date].

prompt_templates.title: Create Channel Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Create campaign messaging for [audience] across email, LinkedIn, paid search, and a landing page. Use this value proposition: [value proposition].

prompt_templates.title: Build Measurement Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a measurement plan for a [campaign type] campaign. Include funnel metrics, UTM naming rules, reporting cadence, and success thresholds.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Full Funnel
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this campaign brief and performance summary. Identify weak points, propose tests, adjust channel mix, and recommend next actions: [brief and data].

output_examples.input: Plan a product launch for a new analytics dashboard.
output_examples.output: A launch brief with objective, audience, positioning, channel mix, asset list, timeline, budget notes, and KPI targets.

output_examples.input: Create email and social content for a lead generation campaign.
output_examples.output: A message framework, subject line options, email body outline, LinkedIn post ideas, paid ad angles, and CTA recommendations.

output_examples.input: Define reporting for a campaign with email, paid search, and organic content.
output_examples.output: A measurement plan with UTM rules, funnel metrics, channel dashboard sections, attribution notes, and review cadence.

best_practices: Provide audience, offer, budget, timeline, and brand constraints before asking for campaign work.
Ask for channel-specific versions instead of one generic message for every platform.
Review claims, legal requirements, and customer data rules before publishing assets.
anti_patterns: Do not use placeholder personas or metrics when real campaign data exists.
Do not publish generated copy without brand, compliance, and factual review.
Do not treat UTM links as a full analytics implementation.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create campaign plans, channel content, templates, KPI plans, and UTM tracking workflows.

faq.question: Can it publish marketing campaigns for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning, writing, and measurement support, but users must publish through their own tools.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide product details, audience segments, brand rules, budget, timeline, channels, and current performance data.

faq.question: Does the Python script access the internet?
faq.answer: No. It generates and validates tracking URL strings and can write CSV output locally.

faq.question: Is this a replacement for marketing strategy review?
faq.answer: No. Human review is still needed for positioning, legal claims, privacy rules, and final publishing decisions.
